stem: Which event contributes most to the narrator's inner conflict in the story?

options.label: F
options.text: She is slow to return home when her grandmother is waiting on her.

options.label: G
options.text: She does not immediately confess to spending money that does not belong to her.

options.label: H
options.text: She is sent to the store by herself and is not used to going there alone.

options.label: J
options.text: She takes a path to the store that is different from her usual route.
